contentText:
Back to basics. | Image: Terrence O’Brien / The Verge

Akai MPC is one of the most storied names in music history. But over the last decade, it's strayed pretty far from its roots as a humble sampler. The modern MPC s run virtual synthesizers, have complex arrangement tools, and sport large touchscreens. They have more in common with your computer running a DAW than they do with the original MPC60 . The MPC Sample is both a return to basics and Akai's triumphant foray into the growing market for portable , battery-powered , and affordable music gear .

The MPC Sample has everything you need to make beats right out of the box. There's a reasonably bright 2.4-inch color screen for editing samples and …
